title: 'checkout' always opens with the full, real order review before asking delivery/pickup

expected.notes: Checkout must never skip straight to asking delivery/pickup without showing the real review first.

title: Checkout on an empty cart is honestly rejected, never opened

expected.notes: canStartCheckout must reject an empty cart — the reply must say so honestly, not pretend to start checkout.

title: Confirming the order review moves to asking delivery or pickup
Selecting delivery moves to address capture
Selecting pickup skips address and moves straight to name capture
A real Karachi-style address is saved and moves to name capture
An implausible 'address' ('yes') is rejected, re-asked, never saved

expected.notes: A bare 'yes' must never be accepted as a delivery address.

title: A plausible name is saved and moves toward submission
'help' is never accepted as the customer's name

expected.notes: Locks the AWAITING_NAME hardening fix — a support-shaped word must never be saved as the name.

title: The final 'confirm' moves to PENDING_VERIFICATION and says 'sent for verification', never 'confirmed'

expected.notes: Since this restaurant requires manual staff verification, 'confirmed' language is never accurate until staff actually calls — the honest wording is 'sent for verification'.

title: 'confirm order' attempted before an address is given is rejected without any success wording

expected.notes: confirm_order attempted while still AWAITING_ADDRESS must be structurally rejected, never falsely claim success.

title: Once past order review (AWAITING_DELIVERY_PICKUP), a cart add attempt is blocked entirely

expected.notes: Locks the checkout-mutation-lock regression: a cart-mutating action must not execute at all once checkout has genuinely started.

title: Checkout continues normally after a blocked mid-checkout edit attempt

expected.notes: The blocked attempt must not corrupt the state machine — a legitimate checkout step right afterward must still work.

title: A plain 'ok' once PENDING_VERIFICATION gets a polite one-time acknowledgement, no repeat finalization message
'thanks' once PENDING_VERIFICATION gets a polite acknowledgement, never mutates the cart
A second acknowledgement after the order is already verified gets a short, distinct 'already in verification' reply

expected.notes: The SECOND acknowledgement must not repeat the full finalization message verbatim.
